name: What safety features should I ensure are working on my automatic gate?

mainEntity.name: What safety features should I ensure are working on my automatic gate?

acceptedAnswer.text: For automatic gates, it's critical to ensure all safety features are fully functional to prevent accidents. These typically include photo-electric sensors that detect obstructions, auto-reverse mechanisms that prevent crushing, and manual release options for emergencies. Regularly testing these features is essential. If any safety feature malfunctions, it should be repaired immediately by a professional. Frasheski Construction prioritizes safety in all gate repairs, ensuring gates in the East Bay area meet operational safety standards.
